stagingPolicy: Static GitHub previews use HTML noindex. Framer preview hosts receive noindex through a hostname-scoped head script; production metadata remains indexable. Native per-environment response headers are unavailable through the connector.
cmsPolicy: Original CMS titles, slugs, article bodies, cover sources and meta descriptions are preserved. Native CMS metadata bindings remain configured. A CMS detail-page script reads the rendered summary, cover and date to supply metadata and JSON-LD when the Framer connector falls back to site defaults. Non-JavaScript social crawlers may still receive the default CMS social card.
